en.title: Trump lauds India's crackdown on poppy farming; lists 23 major drug transit nations
en.summary: Trump praised India's efforts to reduce poppy cultivation and identified 23 countries as major drug transit routes. He called on China to strengthen controls on precursor chemicals used in synthetic drug production.

en.title: At board meet, Noel Tata to push to keep Tata Sons private
en.summary: Noel Tata intends to advocate for maintaining Tata Sons as a private company while still adhering to Reserve Bank of India directives.

stories.title: Govt. cuts windfall tax on export of petrol, diesel and ATF

en.title: Govt. cuts windfall tax on export of petrol, diesel and ATF
en.summary: The Indian government reduced export duties on petroleum products, lowering diesel duty to 20 rupees per litre and petrol duty to 0.5 rupees per litre.

stories.title: Govt lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel

en.title: Govt lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel
en.summary: India's government reduced export duties on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel effective September 16th, with petrol duties falling by one rupee and diesel duties by five rupees per litre.

stories.title: Trump praises PM Modi’s opium crackdown, but India stays on US drug transit list

en.title: Trump praises PM Modi's opium crackdown, but India stays on US drug transit list
en.summary: President Trump commended Prime Minister Modi's efforts to reduce opium poppy cultivation in India, while the US maintained India's designation among 23 countries as major drug transit or producing nations. The US indicated this classification does not indicate failure by India and seeks continued cooperation on drug policy.

en.title: "We Are Very Liberal": Supreme Court On Bail Cases Involving Marijuana
en.summary: India's Supreme Court addressed bail cases involving marijuana, indicating a liberal approach to such matters. The statement was made in response to a plea filed by Biswanath Mandal.

stories.title: Pakistan Navy vessel collides with Indian warship in Arabian Sea

en.title: Pakistan Navy vessel collides with Indian warship in Arabian Sea
en.summary: A Pakistani naval vessel collided with an Indian warship in the Arabian Sea after approaching at high speed. India lodged a formal protest and the Pakistani ship returned to harbour with damage.
